summary: This Form 6-K filed by Mint Incorporation Ltd (BVI company) contains notices for a Class A meeting and an EGM on August 18, 2026. Proposals seek to increase Class B share voting rights from 20 to 200 votes per share and increase authorized shares from 28M to 280M. The board recommends a FOR vote. This is a routine governance charter amendment, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing is a standard proxy solicitation for capital structure adjustments.
